retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic 1970s-style composition featuring a diagonal formation of birds in flight against a soft sky, framed by a geometric Southwestern border and a central circular emblem.

recipe.visualDefinition: A painterly scene of five white swans flying diagonally from top-left to bottom-right across a hazy blue sky, anchored by a top-centered circular medallion and enclosed in a decorative geometric border featuring repeating 'M' and 'W' motifs.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal movement of subjects contrasting with static top-center emblem
Soft, organic bird forms against rigid geometric border patterns
Light-toned subjects against a medium-value sky for high legibility

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five swans distributed across the center and lower-right, scaled to show depth through slight size variations.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A circular emblem at the top center, serving as the origin point for the composition's weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top emblem, follow the text line, and then descend along the diagonal line of the flying birds.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive blue sky occupies the majority of the frame, providing a sense of open air.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and cream (birds and border accents)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Navy blue and ochre (emblem and border details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation sky with high-value subjects; border uses high-contrast dark and light tones.

letterConstructionRules: Top display text uses a fluid, connected script with a heavy underline that integrates into the emblem.
Secondary text is arranged circularly within the emblem's border using a clean, all-caps sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' characters in the script have elongated, sweeping tails.
Underline bar acts as a platform for the script text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid script for primary identity paired with rigid sans-serif for technical/emblematic details.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn feel of the primary display text.
Provides the structured, small-cap feel for the circular text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Paint a soft, hazy blue sky with five white swans flying in a diagonal formation from top-left to bottom-right. Add a geometric border with repeating black, ochre, and cream patterns. Leave the top center clear for an emblem.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a circular navy and ochre medallion at the top center. Add a bold, navy blue script title above the medallion with a horizontal underline. Place secondary text in a circular path inside the medallion's outer ring.

verificationChecks: Is the border geometric and Southwestern in style?
Is the script text underlined and centered?
Is the sky color a soft, atmospheric blue?

adjustableVariables: Color of the sky (dusk vs. midday)
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title

mustAchieve: Balanced geometric symmetry in the border
avoid: Digital gradients that look too smooth

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the birds look like they are in motion.
Check that the border is perfectly aligned and repeating.
Verify the emblem is perfectly centered horizontally.
Confirm the script text feels integrated with the emblem.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Avian Subject] in [Diagonal Formation] with [Geometric Border] and [Top-Centered Emblem] against [Atmospheric Sky].
